limits: Coordination reports are explicitly non-evidence-eligible; no lifecycle acceptance, full G1/G2, archive, release, or source-built proof.
Existing fixture executor only: no physical store execution or independent verification of a cryptographic result/PathInfo signature.
Real generated service credentials, bounded secret provider, signing-key identity validation, ticket creation, keyed verifier admission and durable redemption are exercised.

Readiness is not carried by live-build subscriptions. A transparent Unix proxy forwards original readiness publications and real daemon ACK bytes unchanged; ACK delivery is briefly delayed while querying transient daemon states. No ACK or service publication is synthesized.

Complete framed response bytes are read before the ready publication is forwarded and observed. This is response-emission/read ordering, not an independent syscall trace of the preceding stdout flush.

supported_facts: T3.3 metadata-only exits normally without readiness publisher or coordination change.
T3.3 actual stdio-once is observed started/not-ready with never before request bytes are sent.
T3.3 accepted real ticket is redeemed once and emits exact framed response before observed started+ready, then complete/normal; disconnected terminal row is not-ready with restart action none.
T3.3 unknown-ticket and malformed request controls emit zero stdout and transition started -> failed/abnormal without ready or request acknowledgement.
